camel_example: aliyun cloudfw DescribeVpcFirewallCenList --region cn-hangzhou --RegionNo 'cn-hangzhou' --RouteMode auto --NetworkInstanceId 'vpc-8vbwbo90rq0anm6t0000' --PageSize 10 --MemberUid 2580394279020000 --CurrentPage 1 --TransitRouterType Basic --CenId 'cen-x5jayxou71ad730000' --FirewallSwitchStatus opened --Lang zh --VpcFirewallName 'vpc-firewall-test' --VpcFirewallId 'vfw-m5e7dbc4y0000'
description_en: Retrieves the details of VPC firewalls that protect traffic between a specified VPC and network instances in a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
description_zh: 查询VPC边界防火墙（防护云企业网内的网络实例和指定VPC之间的互访流量）的信息
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-vpc-firewall-cen-list --lang zh --region-no cn-hangzhou --network-instance-id vpc-8vbwbo90rq0anm6t0000 --firewall-switch-status opened --vpc-firewall-id vfw-m5e7dbc4y0000 --vpc-firewall-name vpc-firewall-test --cen-id cen-x5jayxou71ad730000 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --route-mode auto --member-uid 2580394279020000 --transit-router-type Basic --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVpcFirewallCenList

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文。

en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC.

For more information about the regions that Cloud Firewall supports, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195657.html
parameters.help_zh:
VPC所在的地域ID。

关于云防火墙支持地域的详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195657.html
parameters.name: region_no

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network instance
parameters.name: network_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the VPC firewall. Valid values:

opened: The firewall is enabled.

closed: The firewall is disabled.

notconfigured: The firewall is not configured.

configured: The firewall is configured but is disabled.

If you leave this parameter empty, VPC firewalls in all states are queried
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙的状态。取值：

opened：已开启。

closed：已关闭。

notconfigured：表示暂未配置VPC边界防火墙。

configured：表示已配置但未开启VPC边界防火墙。

不设置该参数表示查询所有状态的VPC边界防火墙
parameters.name: firewall_switch_status

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPC firewall
parameters.name: vpc_firewall_id

parameters.help_en: The instance name of the VPC firewall
parameters.help_zh: VPC边界防火墙的实例名称
parameters.name: vpc_firewall_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number to return.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。

默认值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，设置每页包含VPC边界防火墙的数量。

默认值为10，表示每页包含10条结果。最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The routing mode. Valid values:

auto: automatic mode.

manual: manual mode.

If you leave this parameter empty, VPC firewalls that use all routing modes are queried
parameters.help_zh:
路由模式。取值：

auto：表示自动模式。

manual：表示手动模式。

不设置该参数表示查询所有路由模式的VPC边界防火墙
parameters.name: route_mode

parameters.help_en: The UID of a member account that is managed by your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 当前阿里云账号的成员账号（其他阿里云账号）UID
parameters.name: member_uid

parameters.help_en:
The type of the transit router. Valid values:

Basic: Basic Edition transit router.

Enterprise: Enterprise Edition transit router
parameters.help_zh:
转发实例路由器类型。可选值：

Basic：基础版转发路由器。

Enterprise：企业版转发路由器
parameters.name: transit_router_type

ConnectType.description_zh: VPC边界防火墙的互通类型。取值：cen，表示云企业网

FirewallSwitchStatus.description_en:
The status of the VPC firewall. Valid values:

opened: enabled.

notconfigured: not configured

VPC边界防火墙开关的状态。取值：

opened：已开启。

BasicRules.description_en:

0: disabled

基础规则开关。取值：

1：开启状态。

0：关闭状态

EnableAllPatch.description_en:
Indicates whether virtual patching is enabled. Valid values:

1: enabled.

0: disabled

ManualVSwitchId.description_zh: 路由模式为手动模式时指定的vSwitch的ID

NetworkInstanceName.description_en: The name of the network instance

The type of the network instance. Valid values:

VPC: Virtual Private Cloud.

网络实例的类型。取值：

VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）。

VBR（Virtual Border Router）。

CCN（Cloud Connect Network）

OwnerId.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the VPC belongs

1：支持。

0：不支持

The edition of the CEN transit router. Valid values:

云企业网转发路由器（CEN-TR）的版本。取值：

items.description_en: The CIDR blocks of the VPC

DestinationCidr.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the VPC

VpcName.description_en: The instance name of the VPC

MemberUid.description_en: The UID of the member account
MemberUid.description_zh: 当前阿里云账号的成员账号（其他阿里云账号）UID

PrecheckStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the firewall can be automatically created. Cloud Firewall automatically creates a firewall and protects VPC traffic based on route learning. Valid values:

passed: The firewall can be automatically created.

failed: The firewall cannot be automatically created.

unknown: The status is unknown
PrecheckStatus.description_zh:
是否可以自动开墙，即云防火墙会根据路由学习，自动防护VPC流量。取值：

passed：可以自动开墙。

failed：不可以自动开墙。

unknown：未知状态

RegionStatus.description_en:
The status of the region. Valid values:

enable: VPC firewalls can be configured in the region.

disable: VPC firewalls cannot be configured in the region
RegionStatus.description_zh:
地域开放状态。取值：

enable：已开放，表示该地域允许配置VPC边界防火墙。

disable：未开放，表示该地域不允许配置VPC边界防火墙

ResultCode.description_en:
The result code of the operation to create the VPC firewall. Valid values:

Unauthorized: The VPC firewall cannot be created because a network instance is not authorized.

RegionDisable: The VPC firewall cannot be created because the region of the network instance is not supported.

OpsDisable: The VPC firewall cannot be created.

VbrNotSupport: The VPC firewall cannot be created because the VBR in the CEN instance is not supported.

An empty string indicates that the VPC firewall can be created for the network instance
ResultCode.description_zh:
创建VPC边界防火墙的操作结果代码。取值：

Unauthorized：表示存在未授权的网络实例, 不允许创建VPC边界防火墙。

RegionDisable：表示网络实例所在的地域是VPC边界防火墙不支持的地域, 不允许创建VPC边界防火墙。

OpsDisable：表示不允许创建VPC边界防火墙。

VbrNotSupport：表示云企业网中的VBR不支持创建VPC边界防火墙。

空字符串，表示该网络实例可以正常创建VPC边界防火墙

VpcFirewallId.description_en: The instance ID of the VPC firewall

VpcFirewallName.description_en: The instance name of the VPC firewall
VpcFirewallName.description_zh: VPC边界防火墙的实例名称
